title: Regulating Artificial Intelligence Design to Prevent Youth Mental Health Harms
summary_en: This viewpoint examines the mental health risks AI chatbots pose to young people and outlines four regulatory priorities, including safety standards, independent testing, protective defaults, and harm monitoring.
title_cn: Regulating Artificial Intelligence Design to Prevent Youth Mental Health Harms

title: Suicide-Related Responses From AI Chatbots Through Application Programming Interfaces and Consumer-Facing Apps: Observational Cross-Sectional Comparative Study
summary_en: This study examines how frequently AI chatbots provide direct responses to suicide-related prompts across access modes and whether response patterns differ between consumer-facing UI and API access across models and prompt risk levels.
title_cn: Suicide-Related Responses From AI Chatbots Through Application Programming Interfaces and Consumer-Facing Apps: Observational Cross-Sectional Comparative Study
